name: @agent-plugins-doctor/report
description: Report generation (human, JSON, Markdown) for Agent Plugin Doctor

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target node && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --outDir ./dist --rootDir ./src --target ES2022 --module ES2022 --moduleResolution bundler --esModuleInterop --resolveJsonModule --skipLibCheck --strict src/index.ts && cp ../../LICENSE ./dist/LICENSE && cp ../../README.md ./dist/README.md
